title: Rowan Ellery
tagline: Designer and developer in Bellingham, Washington. Calm software, maps and film photography.
name: Rowan Ellery
avatarAlt: Rowan Ellery, in shadow, holding a film camera
headline: I design software by day and chase light *above treeline* by weekend.
bio: I’m Rowan, a designer and developer in Bellingham, Washington. I run Switchback Studio, a two-person practice that builds tools for outdoor brands, parks groups and anyone who works where the signal drops. Most weekends I’m above treeline with a film camera.
